name: ES Three-Auction Value Ladder v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit per slot
research_motivation: Prior candidates suggest that persistent accepted-value migration across participant handoffs is more credible than forecasting direction from isolated volume, volatility, sentiment, or auction-shape indicators. The same rule is repeated across fixed slots to reduce researcher degrees of freedom.

shared_rule.auction_center: volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price, where typical price is (high + low + close) / 3
shared_rule.long_signal: first auction center < second auction center < third auction center
shared_rule.short_signal: first auction center > second auction center > third auction center
shared_rule.entry: one-minute open immediately following the third auction plus one adverse ES tick
shared_rule.stop_fill: second auction center plus one adverse ES tick
shared_rule.same_bar_rule: if the entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
shared_rule.survivor_exit: 15:55 open plus one adverse ES tick

portfolio_limits.maximum_gross_position: three MES if all slot positions survive and overlap

lesson: Monotonic auction-center movement is descriptive but not sufficient evidence of persistent accepted inventory. The apparent edge was a 2022 opening-window artifact, while shorts and later windows lost. No side, year, or slot filter is permitted after observing these results.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the frozen aggregate failed its development gates.
